name: bookmcp
description: Book knowledge for system design and implementation, with cited local PDF retrieval.
long_description: Give your assistant book knowledge for system design and implementation. Discover your engineering books through a compact library index, search with BM25, retrieve cited principles to inform architecture trade-offs, and read saved design lessons. Ingest text-based PDFs and save reviewed lessons with the BookMCP CLI. The MCP interface is read-only. BookMCP makes no hosted AI calls; passages retrieved by your assistant are subject to that assistant's privacy settings. Includes native executables for macOS Intel/Apple Silicon, Linux x86-64/ARM64 (glibc 2.35+), and Windows x86-64.
